projects.title: KeyMitra — A Key to Everyday Ease
projects.description: KeyMitra is a team project supporting roadside keymakers with digital customer and key records. As the UI/UX and app designer, I translated field observations into user flows, wireframes, and interface designs. Research highlighted compact workspaces, hard-to-access tools and key blanks, repetitive searching, and manual customer records. The prototype was tested with keymakers, and their feedback informed refinements. The concept also supports key-blank inventory; faster retrieval and less paper are intended benefits, not measured outcomes.
projects.summary: UI/UX and app design for roadside keymakers. I translated field research into user flows, wireframes, and interfaces for customer and key records. Tested with keymakers; their feedback informed refinements.

projects.title: Dear Zindagi — Life Through My Lens
projects.description: Our teacher asked us to shoot an introduction for our favourite movie. I chose Dear Zindagi because it felt personally relatable, and I filmed this introduction while learning photography and videography. This is a student-shot study inspired by the film, exploring framing, light, and everyday moments.
projects.summary: I filmed a classroom introduction inspired by my favourite, personally relatable movie. A photography and videography study in framing, light, and everyday storytelling.

projects.title: Tomorrow, Dreamed in Motion
projects.description: I made this video while experimenting with AI tools. I loved exploring how a prompt could become a moving image, trying different visual directions, and seeing an imagined future take shape on screen.
projects.summary: An AI motion experiment exploring imagined futures, cities, technology, and nature. A 49-second portrait film; the full story includes scene descriptions and source marks.
